name: Per-seat team billing
needs: update the bill when someone joins the team
how many seats does this workspace pay for
prorate when a team adds a user mid month
summary: A team subscription whose quantity equals the number of paid members. Adding or removing a member changes the quantity, the payment provider prorates the difference, and your app blocks invites past the paid count if you want hard limits.
need_when: You sell to teams and price grows with the number of people using it.
skip_when: Plans are flat per workspace, or most customers are solo users.

ways.title: Subscription quantity at your payment provider
ways.how: Stripe, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy subscriptions have a quantity. Update it when membership changes and let the provider prorate.
ways.tradeoff: Standard and well documented. You decide when to sync, and whether removals take effect now or at renewal.

ways.title: Buy seats up front
ways.how: Admins pick a seat count. Invites beyond it ask them to buy more first.
ways.tradeoff: Predictable bills, no surprise charges. One more step before inviting.

ways.title: True-up later
ways.how: Let teams add people freely and bill the extra seats on the next invoice.
ways.tradeoff: No friction. Some customers dislike surprise increases.

prompt:
Add per-seat billing for team workspaces using [Stripe] subscriptions.

Requirements:
- Each workspace has one subscription. Quantity = active paid members (pending invites [do / don't] count).
- When a member is added or removed, update the subscription quantity with proration [now / at renewal]. Do it in a background job with retries.
- Store seats_paid on the workspace from webhook events, not from the API response alone.
- Only workspace owners and billing admins can change seats or see invoices.
- Show the current seat count, price per seat and next invoice estimate on the billing page.
- If seats_paid < members (failed sync or payment), block new invites and show a fix-it message. Never lock out existing members.
- Write tests for add, remove, downgrade at renewal and failed payment.

Acceptance checks (run each and show me the result):
1. Adding a member raises the subscription quantity by one within a minute.
2. Removing a member lowers it as configured, with the proration line on the next invoice.
3. A non-admin can't open the billing page.
4. A failed quantity update retries and alerts, and the app shows the mismatch.
5. Seat count in your database matches the provider after replaying webhooks.
acceptance_checks: Adding a member raises the subscription quantity by one within a minute.
Removing a member lowers it as configured, with the proration line on the next invoice.
A non-admin can't open the billing page.
A failed quantity update retries and alerts, and the app shows the mismatch.
Seat count in your database matches the provider after replaying webhooks.
if_you_skip_it: Teams use 40 seats while paying for 5, or get charged for people they removed months ago.
